label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 130
title: Dashboard logs: dashboard/logs/dashboard.log + per-run streaming/API of agent logs
body:
## Original (as captured)
Own dashboard log channel (dashboard/logs/dashboard.log via core/log_router) + API/UI to list/stream per-run per-agent logs (logs/<run_id>/INDEX.json). Pairs with the backend log conventions.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0153)
config/log-conventions.json + core/log_router.py (single writer). Layout: products/<project>/logs/<run_id>/<stage>-<agent>.log (per agent), <run_id>-pipeline.log (overall/run), product-forge/logs/pipeline-backend.log, dashboard/logs/dashboard.log. Line format ts|level|run_id|stage|agent|event|message; logs/<run_id>/INDEX.json lists logs+sizes. Wired: agent_runner (agent_start/complete), stage_runner (stage_complete + INDEX), run_entry (backend + run log). One writer per file.
